note: Positions are anchored to unmistakable landforms in the real DEM/ortho by manual identification (method in alignment_report.json); positionUncertaintyM expresses that identification limit, not instrument precision. Science objectives come from the cited Mars 2020 mission records. samplingDurationMin is left to Phase 2.

sites.name: Delta front strata overlook
sites.objective: Observe stacked delta-front sedimentary strata at the scarp base - the lake-to-delta transition of the ancient Jezero lake system documented by the Mars 2020 mission.
sites.positioningMethod: manual identification of the delta front scarp base on the CTX ortho extract and DEM hillshade

sites.name: Delta top channel junction
sites.objective: Inspect delta-top distributary channel deposits; delta sedimentary rocks were the target of Mars 2020's second science campaign, including organic-matter detections in lake sediments.
sites.positioningMethod: manual identification of a distributary channel junction on the delta top in the CTX ortho extract and DEM hillshade

sites.name: Small fresh crater (crater floor)
sites.objective: Examine a small fresh impact crater exposing subsurface crater-floor material; crater-floor rocks were the focus of the mission's first science campaign.
sites.positioningMethod: center of a distinct bright-rimmed crater visible in both the CTX ortho extract and the DEM hillshade (also control point CP1)
